evidence: Static text review of the agent-visible brief (instruction.md, 116 words) and the six /instructions notes (1721 words); this row needs no runtime measurement. (1) Spelling: all seven files read in full, plus a review of the 625-entry unique-word list extracted from them; no misspelling found. British spelling is used consistently (behaviour, colour, coloured, colouring); a case-insensitive grep for 'color' and 'behavior' returns nothing. Product names (CodeMirror, Monaco, Ace, ProseMirror, TipTap, Quill, Slate, Draft.js) are spelled correctly at ui.md:3. No doubled words (regex for repeated adjacent word: no hits), no double spaces, no non-ASCII bytes, no CR, no BOM. (2) Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder, Windows drive paths, /home/, /Users/, and criterion|rubric|judge|golden over instruction.md and environment/** returns no matches. The template stub 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' (template instruction.md:1) has been replaced. Every path is an absolute container path (/instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /app/node_modules). No author asides or duplicated paragraphs. (3) Internal consistency: instruction.md:3 says 'six notes in /instructions' and exactly six files exist and are copied by environment/Dockerfile:14; the seed path /assets/seed_data.json is the same at instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 and the file exists with an empty snippets array, matching 'contains no user snippets'; serve-at-/ agrees between instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3; no-sign-in agrees across instruction.md:5, overview.md:3 and policy.md:3; Node 22 / Express / better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH at integration.md:5 matches environment/Dockerfile:1-12; port 3000, /app/server.js, /api/health and DB_PATH at integration.md:3,9 match tests/test.sh:48,97,106-109. The two 'five second' values are different quantities (run budget, behaviour.md:5; library refresh latency, behaviour.md:11), not two clock values for one thing. The network statements agree (integration.md:5 defers to security.md; security.md:3). Observations that do not reach a defect for this row: policy.md:3 grants freedom over 'labels, routes' while integration.md:3 fixes / and GET /api/health and ui.md:17 names the controls; integration.md:5 restates 'You may choose your routes' directly after the fixed ones, so this reads as general latitude with stated exceptions rather than a contradiction. The voice shifts from 'I' to 'We start it' at integration.md:3, which is a naturalness matter for check 2, not spelling or contamination. Not verified by this reviewer: the input SHA256 and the raw-evidence artifact hashes, neither of which bears on this row.
